_comment: A2A protocol example. Copy to config.json and fill in. Never commit real secrets.
_auth_mode_note: Use 'devicecode' (single account) or 'pool' (multi-account wizard, recommended for load tests). Both work with a PUBLIC CLIENT app registration -- no secret needed. See README 'App registration' section for how to create one with the A2A/MCP scopes pre-consented. Only use 'a2a_confidential'/'mcp_confidential' if you must use a pre-existing CONFIDENTIAL (secret-required) app registration you don't control.
prompts: Hello, can you tell me what you can help with?
